indicator_name: Resources and use of individual products, January to the month (year-to-date), physical units
description: Ресурсы и использование отдельных видов продукции (товаров) и сырья, с начала года (январь–месяц)
methodology: Same items as RESOURCE_USE_MONTHLY; dated the first day of the last month (January–July 2026 = 2026-07-01). The latest print of each cumulative figure -- BNS revises earlier months only inside it, so the sum of RESOURCE_USE_MONTHLY can differ (wheat exports January–July 2026: 4.95 Mt here, 5.99 Mt summing the months).
transformation: level (year-to-date cumulative, as published -- not decumulated to months)
